import os
import sys
import warnings
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def solve():
    # Define paths
    train_path = "./input/train.csv"
    test_path = "./input/test.csv"
    sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
    submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

    # Load Data
    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)  # Verify format

    # Identify columns
    id_col = "Id"
    target_col = "Cover_Type"
    feature_cols = [
        col for col in train_df.columns if col != id_col and col != target_col
    ]

    # Prepare features and labels
    X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    y_train_full = train_df[target_col].values.copy()
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
    test_ids = test_df[id_col].values.astype(np.int64)

    # Use proper LabelEncoder to ensure consistent label encoding across splits
    le = LabelEncoder()
    le.fit(y_train_full)  # Encode with ALL unique labels from training

    # Reencode with fitted encoder to handle potential inconsistencies
    y_train_encoded = le.transform(y_train_full)

    # Create hold-out validation set that NEVER trains on (proper hold-out)
    # This split ensures we evaluate on data never used in fitting
    X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_full, y_train_encoded, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, shuffle=True
    )

    # Train LightGBM Classifier WITHOUT refit on validation data
    clf = LGBMClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        max_depth=-1,
        num_leaves=31,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        n_jobs=-1,
        force_col_wise=False,
    )
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

    # Evaluate on truly held-out validation set (not used for training)
    val_pred = clf.predict(X_val)
    val_enc_pred = le.inverse_transform(val_pred)
    validation_acc = accuracy_score(y_val, val_enc_pred)
    print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {validation_acc:.4f}")

    # Generate predictions for the actual test set
    test_pred = clf.predict(X_test)

    # Ensure directory exists
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(submission_path), exist_ok=True)

    # Save submission
    submission_data = {id_col: test_ids, target_col: test_pred}
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data)
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
    print("Done.")
